verdict.rationale: Channel3's own price-tracking feature lets a user subscribe to a product and automatically receive webhook notifications when its price changes. That is a narrow, single-event trigger rather than a general rules engine. Missing for 10: user-definable rule conditions (e.g., thresholds or filters), multiple event types beyond price change, configurable actions other than a webhook, depth of documentation on rule setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
